title: 第9章 交给你们了第10章 变成鬼
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
“娘！”
塔子晃神之际，随即痛彻心扉的喊道。
单手抽出身后大刀，红光乍现，血纹露出，冲向黑甲侍卫，大刀劈下“我杀了你！”
古力山，古力扎兄弟二人也是怒之抽刀迎战。
黑甲侍卫一声冷笑“壹纹战士而已，如此猖狂！”
双臂血纹复现，大喝一声，数道刀影飞出，每一道刀气飞出，迎风即涨，向塔子三人飞去。
此时其余的部落战士也与另外两名黑甲侍卫战作一团。
阿皓看着四周正在悲伤哭泣的伙伴，对于这帮孩子来说，班如婶婶已经和自己的亲娘没有区别，她是部落里所有孩子的母亲，对待他们比对自己孩子塔子还好，虽然不少孩子屁股都挨过班如婶婶的胖揍，但是没有一个孩子对其有过怨言。
谁是真心对你，孩子们是最清楚地。
此时阿皓突然用力朝自己脸上一拳，头脑从悲痛中清醒过来，喊道：“所有人！
快速进洞中逃离！”
平时惯于听从阿皓的安排，此时少年少女都缓过神，虽面色悲痛，但都听从阿皓的话，加速冲进洞中。
“快点！
不要管物资了！”
阿皓站在洞口，催促伙伴们进入。
突然伸手握着那十六，急速道：“守着我！”
说罢便低声道“鹰眼视觉！”
身边化为白色线条，视角随之升空，在鹰眼视觉的帮助下，看到了外面已经死伤惨重的族人，和已经解决掉两个黑甲战士的巴安和戈子，正与受伤的岩蒙连手对抗着那灰袍男子。
“不愧是圣塔白晶牛，气血与肉体都超出同等级别，桀桀，我蛇达已经好久没有如此兴奋了！”
在声声奸笑中，只见那蛇达身后也出现了十几米长，二人粗的巨蛇通身乌黑，盘在一起宛如一座小山。

硕大的瞳孔阴森森的看着面前渺小的三人，斯斯地吐着信子。
不像岩蒙的若隐若现的图腾，这只巨蛇像是真实存在的血兽一般，散发出阵阵威压。
透骨环血蛇图腾，百年前也是华古洲其中的一个中型部落的部落图腾，被天元部落吞并后，其所有族中战士被天元部落收之为奴隶战士，此图腾的血纹战士均靠吸食血液提高气血，据说越是高等的血兽或是血纹战士的血液，越是对他们有着致命的吸引力。
只见巨蛇蛇尾一摆扫中巴安的胸口，“轰”
的一声巨响后，一股巨力爆炸开来。
此时贰纹战士巴安双手不及抵挡。
被这股巨力，震的抛飞开来。
“巴安！”
岩蒙喊道。
看向蛇达身后那巨蛇，剑眉之下露出震动绝望的神色，“伍纹战士……”
四纹化形，伍纹点睛。
岩蒙此时虽然已步入四纹门槛，但是还没有来得及去天元部落寻找刻纹师，进行刻纹仪式。
连师是黄阶刻纹师，天元部落是不允许属下部落中出现玄阶刻纹师的，所有四纹战士想要刻纹必须要到天元部落申报，允许后才可找刻纹师帮其刻纹。
当四纹战士刻纹后，图腾便会凝聚成型，战士气力大增，当达到伍纹时便是点睛，点睛后，图腾血兽会生有意识，形成一个只听命于自己的新的生命。
平时藏在本主肉体当中，战士用自身气血供养，作战时将其放出，无需控制，可以意念沟通，二者配合发出最大的战力。
只见巨蛇张开巨口露出口中利牙，咬向岩蒙，在岩蒙躲闪之际，一股带着灭亡的气息的手抓向岩蒙。
“小心！”
戈子此时飞奔上前左手推开重伤的岩蒙，巨斧挥舞，砍向蛇达。
撕拉一声，巨蛇转头一咬，一条断臂掉落半空之中。
在斧头与蛇达利爪相交，此时已然独臂的戈子只觉一股至阴至邪，无坚不摧的力量压来，整个人就像被一辆青铜马车撞中，胸口气血翻腾，噔噔倒退了数步。

就在着弹指之间，不知躲藏在何处的连师忽然出现，咬破手指单手以自身鲜血在眉心绘纹，单手结印“冥神刺！”
连师是普通的黄阶刻纹师，并不是像觉醒纹师的阿皓，但是这不影响刻纹师自有的独特能力，以血液为基，自身精神力为代价，可绘制各种攻击图腾，此时的冥神刺就是一个极端的攻击方法，将全部精神力化为尖刺，攻击对方的神识。
毫无防备，也可以说不曾想象岩牛部落会有此法的蛇达，在反应时已经中了此招，脑中如同被尖刀刺入，双目流血，抱头痛呼，与之蛇达同心同体的巨蛇也是疼痛难忍，倒地嘶吼着拍打着地面。
在连师大喊快动手时，岩蒙与刚刚爬起巴安，顾不得失去左手的戈子三人，纷纷冲向蛇达。
“白晶爆碎！”
content_en:
"Mother!"
When Ta Zi was stunned, he immediately shouted in pain.
He drew out the big knife behind him with one hand. Red light suddenly appeared and blood lines were exposed. He rushed towards the black-armored guard and slashed down with the big knife. "I'll kill you!"
In Guli Mountain, the Guliza brothers also drew their swords in anger to fight.
The black-armored guard sneered, "It's just a Yiwen warrior, so arrogant!"
The blood lines on both arms reappeared, and with a loud shout, several sword shadows flew out. Each sword energy flew out, swelled up in the wind, and flew towards the three people in the tower.
At this time, the remaining tribe warriors were also fighting with the other two black-armored guards.
Ah Hao looked at the sad and crying companions around him. To these children, Aunt Banru was no different from his own mother. She was the mother of all the children in the tribe, and she treated them better than her own child Tazi. Although many children had been beaten by Aunt Banru, no child had ever complained about her.
Children know best who is sincere to you.
At this time, Ah Hao suddenly punched himself in the face, his mind came to his senses from grief, and he shouted: "Everyone!
Escape quickly into the cave! "
Usually, they were accustomed to obeying A Hao's arrangements. At this time, the boy and the girl all calmed down. Although their expressions were sad, they all obeyed A Hao's words and rushed into the cave at high speed.
"Hurry up!
Forget about supplies! "
Ahao stood at the entrance of the cave, urging his friends to enter.
Suddenly he stretched out his hand to hold the sixteenth man and said quickly: "Guard me!"
After that, he whispered "Eagle Vision!"
The surroundings turned into white lines, and the perspective rose into the sky. With the help of eagle vision, he saw the tribesmen outside who had suffered heavy casualties, and Ba'an and Gezi, who had already eliminated two black-armored warriors, were joining hands with the injured Yanmeng to fight against the gray-robed man.
"As expected of the Holy Tower White Crystal Ox, the energy, blood and body are beyond the same level. Jie Jie, I, Snake Da, haven't been so excited for a long time!"
Amidst the evil laughter, a giant snake that was more than ten meters long and two people thick appeared behind the snake. Its body was black and coiled together like a small mountain.
The huge pupils looked at the three small people in front of them sinisterly, spitting out the letter.
Unlike Yan Meng's looming totem, this giant snake looks like a real blood beast, exuding bursts of pressure.
The bone-penetrating blood snake totem was the tribal totem of one of the medium-sized tribes in Huagu Continent a hundred years ago. After it was annexed by the Tianyuan tribe, all the warriors in the tribe were taken as slave warriors by the Tianyuan tribe. The blood-striped warriors of this totem rely on blood to increase their energy and blood. It is said that the higher the blood beast or the blood of the blood-striped warrior, the more fatal it is to them.
I saw the giant snake swing its tail and hit Baan's chest, "Boom"
After a loud noise, a huge force exploded.
At this time, Ba'an, the second pattern warrior, could not resist with his hands.
It was thrown away by this huge force.
"Baan!"
Yanmeng shouted.
Looking at the giant snake behind Sheda, a look of shock and despair appeared under his sword eyebrows, "Wu Wen warrior..."
The four lines transform into shape, and the five lines add the finishing touch.
Although Yan Meng has entered the threshold of the four patterns at this time, he has not yet had time to go to the Tianyuan tribe to find a pattern engraver and perform the pattern engraving ceremony.
The company master is a yellow-level engraver. The Tianyuan tribe does not allow Xuan-level engravers to appear in its subordinate tribes. All four-level warriors who want to have engravings must report to the Tianyuan tribe. Only after permission can they find an engraver to help them engrave.
When the four-marked warrior is carved, the totem will condense and form, and the warrior's strength will be greatly increased. When it reaches the fifth-marked mark, it will be the finishing touch. After the finishing touch, the totem blood beast will become conscious and form a new life that only obeys its own orders.
It is usually hidden in the body of the owner, and the warrior uses his own energy and blood to support it. It is released during battle. It does not need to be controlled and can be communicated with thoughts. The two work together to produce the greatest combat power.
I saw the giant snake opening its huge mouth, revealing its sharp teeth, and biting Yan Meng. When Yan Meng dodged, a hand with the aura of death grabbed Yan Meng.
"careful!"At this time, Ge Zi rushed forward and pushed away the seriously injured Yan Meng with his left hand. He swung his giant ax and slashed at Snake Da.
With a tearing sound, the giant snake turned its head and bit, and a severed arm fell into the air.
When the ax and the snake's sharp claws intersected, Gezi, who was already one-armed, felt an extremely sinister and invincible force pressing down on him. His whole body felt like he had been hit by a bronze carriage. The blood in his chest surged, and he stumbled back a few steps.
Just in the blink of an eye, the company master who was hiding suddenly appeared, biting his finger and using his own blood to draw a pattern on the center of his eyebrow with one hand, and formed the seal "Pluto of the Underworld" with one hand!
Lian Shi is an ordinary yellow-level engraver, not A Hao like the awakened engraver, but this does not affect the unique ability of the engraver. It is based on blood and at the cost of one's own mental power. It can draw various attack totems. At this time, the Hades Thorn is an extreme attack method, turning all the mental power into spikes to attack the opponent's spiritual consciousness.
Snake Da, who was unprepared and had never imagined that the Yanniu tribe would have such a technique, had already been hit by this move when he reacted. His head felt like being stabbed by a sharp knife, his eyes were bleeding, and he cried with his head in his arms. The giant snake that shared the same body as Snake Da was also in unbearable pain, and fell to the ground, roaring and slapping the ground.
When the company commander shouted to start quickly, Yanmeng and Gezi, who had just climbed up from Ba'an and didn't care about losing his left hand, rushed towards Sheda.
"The white crystal explodes!"
